PROCEDURE ZZ (M varchar2) IS
/* --------------------------------------------------------------------*
ZZ is a debug message process used for debugging. Modified from
ZDebug form. To enable use of the Debug button in the Debug block
set its canvas to CANVAS1.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------*

Using This Procedure
--------------------
 Procedure ZZ stores and displays debugging messages. To see a 
 message from anywhere in your form, simply code a command such as:
 zz('Any message here');
 If debugging has been activated (by clicking the Debug button),
 the message is stored for display when requested.
 
 The input M parameter is used to pass debugging messages and also
 to control the debug process. If the text in M is anything other
 than the control values below, it is considered a message to be
 stored and displayed.

 Control commands: If the M parameter is set to any of the values
 below, they are used as controls to direct this process. Normally,
 you do not need to code any message calls to use these commands,
 since they are already set up in the 'Click_control' procedure
 below, which is used by a call from the B1.DEBUG button.
 If M is any of the following values, this process performs the
 described action:
 'TOGGLE' to turn on/off message storage
 'TOGGLEI' turn on message storage AND display messages to screen
 immediately as they are generated.
 'TOGGLE0' (TOGGLE and Zero) Turn off message storage
 'TOGGLE1' Turn on message storage
 'SHOW_MSGS' to display messages via zdebug form
 'CLEAR' to delete all stored messages
 'CONTROL' is issued from the When-Mouse-Click trigger. Controls
 actions within this process. Actions are described in the
 notes in the WMC trigger on the debug button.
 anything else: writes into rec group 'ZDEBUG'.
*/

 RG RecordGroup := find_group('ZDEBUG');
 RG_Col GroupColumn;
 Toggle_msg varchar2(100);
 Btn_label varchar2(20);
 ----
 Procedure msg(M1 varchar2) is begin
 Add_Group_Row(RG,END_OF_GROUP);
 set_group_char_cell('ZDEBUG.TXT', get_group_row_count(RG), M1);
 if substr(:GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG,1,1) = 'I' -- I = Immediate msg:
 then 
 -- Also write message to screen in a pop-up window --
 if :GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG = 'I' then
 Message(M1);
 message(' ',no_acknowledge);
 elsif :GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG = 'I1' then
 Message(M1);
 else --'I1NA'
 Message(M1,no_acknowledge);
 end if;
 end if;
 End msg;
 ----
 Procedure Click_Control is
 -- Mouse_button_modifiers is a text string which is null or is a
 -- combination of: control+ shift+ and alt+
 key_shift_state pls_integer -- counts '+' characters
 := Nvl(length(:System.Mouse_button_modifiers)
 - length(translate(:System.Mouse_button_modifiers,'A+','A')),0);
 Begin
 If key_shift_state = 0 then
 Default_value('N','GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG');
 Clear_Message;
 Message
 (' 1 shift=Toggle debug; 2=Show messages; 3=Clear messages'
 ||', Alt only=ToggleI: msgs to screen. Msg_Flag='
 ||:GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG
 ||' Msgs='|| get_group_row_count('ZDEBUG')
 ,no_acknowledge);
 Elsif key_shift_state = 1 then
 if :System.Mouse_button_modifiers = 'Alt+' then
 ZZ('TOGGLEI');
 else
 ZZ('TOGGLE');
 end if;
 Elsif key_shift_state = 2 then
 ZZ('SHOW_MSGS');
 Else -- key_shift_state = 3
 ZZ('CLEAR');
 End if;
 End Click_Control;
 ----
 Procedure msg2(M2 varchar2) is begin
 Clear_Message; --so message already on status line will not pop up.
 Message(M2,no_acknowledge);
 End msg2;
 ----
PROCEDURE P01_Display_Messages is
-- Copies all messages in record group into Debug.Debug_msgs
-- If total messages take up more than 32767 bytes, the limit that
-- can be displayed in one item, the rest of the messages are
-- not displayed, and no alert message is given.
--
 txt varchar2(32767);
 len_1 pls_integer := 0;
 len_2 pls_integer;
 rg_txt varchar2(4001);
 txt_id GroupColumn;
 trunc boolean := false;
 RG RecordGroup := Find_Group('ZDEBUG');
BEGIN
 Go_Item('DEBUG.CURRENT_CURSOR_ITEM');
 If get_group_row_count(RG) = 0 then
 :Debug.Debug_msgs := chr(10)||' No messages to display.';
 Else
 txt_id := find_column('ZDEBUG.TXT');
 For i in 1..get_group_row_count(RG) loop
 rg_txt := get_group_char_cell(txt_id,i) || chr(10);
 len_2 := least( length(rg_txt)
 , 32767 - len_1); -- Available space left in txt.
 txt := txt || substr(rg_txt,1,len_2);
 len_1 := len_1 + len_2;
 If len_2 < length(rg_txt) then
 trunc := true;
 exit;
 End if;
 End loop;
 :Debug.Debug_msgs := txt;
 If trunc then
 Message(' Display has been truncated to 32,767 bytes');
 Message(' ',no_acknowledge);
 End if;
 End if;
END;


BEGIN
 -- Initialization: create global variable and record group
 Default_value('N','GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG');
 if id_null(RG) then
 RG := Create_group('ZDEBUG',Global_Scope);
 RG_Col := Add_group_column(RG,'TXT',Char_column,4000);
 end if;
 ----
 if upper(M) = 'CONTROL' then
 --- Debug button clicked --
 Click_Control;
 elsif upper(M) = 'SHOW_MSGS' then 
 --- Show Messages ---
 If get_group_row_count(RG) = 0
 and id_null(find_timer('ZDEBUG')) then
 Msg2(' No messages to display. '
 ||'Click again (within 5 seconds) to call zDebug form.');
 if id_null(Create_timer('ZDEBUG',5000,no_repeat)) then
 null;
 end if;
 else
 Clear_Message;
 P01_Display_Messages;
 end if;
 ---
 elsif substr(upper(M),1,6) = 'TOGGLE' then
 --- Toggle Messages ---
 If upper(M)='TOGGLEI' then
 :GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG := 'I';
 Btn_label := 'Set Msg flag OFF';
 Toggle_msg := 'Msg_Flag set to I -- Messages output to screen';
 elsif upper(M)='TOGGLE1'
 or upper(M)='TOGGLE'
 and nvl(:GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG,' ') in('N',' ') then
 :GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG := 'Y';
 Btn_label := 'Set Msg flag OFF';
 Toggle_msg := 'Msg_Flag set to Y -- Messages can now '
 ||'be created. Msgs='|| get_group_row_count('ZDEBUG');
 else -- all other conditions:
 -- M='TOGGLE0' or M='TOGGLE' and Global in('Y','I')
 :GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG := 'N';
 Btn_label := 'Set Msg flag ON';
 Toggle_msg := 'Msg_Flag set to N -- Messages will no longer '
 ||'be created. Msgs='|| get_group_row_count('ZDEBUG');
 end if;
 Msg2(' ' || Toggle_msg);
 -- If running inside zDebug form, change button label:
 If not id_null(find_item('B1.DEBUG_MSG_ON_OFF')) then
 set_item_property('B1.DEBUG_MSG_ON_OFF',Label,Btn_Label);
 End if;
 ---
 elsif upper(M) = 'CLEAR' then
 --- Clear Messages ---
 Msg2(' All ( '||get_group_row_count(RG)
 ||' ) stored messages cleared. Msg_Flag='
 ||:GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG);
 delete_group_row(RG,all_rows);
 ---
 elsif nvl(:GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG,' ') <> 'N' then
 Msg(M); -- store/display msg
 end if;
END ZZ;

Procedure P06_Find_Uniques(Find_all varchar2 := 'N') is --*
-----------------------------
-- Find all items where one of the possible values is unique
-- to this item (it is not a possibility in any other item in
-- the same row or same column or same box.)
-- When a unique value is found, remove that value from all the other
-- possibles in the same row, column and group.
-- The technique of finding unique single values is Technique #1,
-- "Single Position" at www.sudokuoftheday.com
--
-- When Find_all = Y, the process repeats until no more unique values
-- can be found. Since finding a unique value limits the values
-- available to other fields, repeating can find more unique singles.
-- The parameter is Y only when called by the "Quick Solve" process.
-- 
 P varchar2(9); --possible values string
 C1 varchar2(1); --single char from P.
 C2 varchar2(3); --C1 between %: %C%
 P1 varchar2(9); --possible vals from string to check
 cnt_single pls_integer;
 found1 boolean;
 Found_string varchar2(256);

 Procedure check_row(r pls_integer,c pls_integer) is begin
 -------------------
 found1 := false;
 for j in 1..9 loop
 If j <> c then
 P1 := Name_in('P.B'||r||j);
 found1 := P1 like C2; --True if char in C1 is found in P1
 Exit when found1;
 End if;
 End loop;
 End check_row;


 Procedure check_column(r pls_integer,c pls_integer) is begin
 ----------------------
 found1 := false;
 for i in 1..9 loop
 If i <> r then
 P1 := Name_in('P.B'||i||c);
 found1 := P1 like C2; --True if char in C1 is found in P1
 Exit when found1;
 End if;
 End loop;
 End check_column;


 Procedure check_box(r pls_integer,c pls_integer) is
 -------------------
 i pls_integer := trunc((r-1)/3)*3+1; --r,c of first item of a box
 j pls_integer := trunc((c-1)/3)*3+1;
 Begin
 found1 := false;
 for a in i..i+2 loop
 for b in j..j+2 loop
 If a <> r or b <> c then
 P1 := Name_in('P.B'||a||b);
 --found1 := P1 like C2; --True if char in C1 is found in P1
 if instr(P1,C1)>0 then--True if char in C1 is found in P1
 found1 := True;
 Exit;
 end if;
 End if;
 End loop;
 Exit when found1;
 End loop;
 End check_box;


 Function Duplicate_Single(i number,j number)
 -----------------------------
 Return boolean is
 -- This function compares the single character hint value at the i,j
 -- coordinates with all other hint numbers in the row, column and box,
 -- and if a duplicate single hint is found, returns TRUE.
 -- Otherwise returns False.
 Rtrn_TF Boolean := False;
 C1 varchar2(9) := Name_in('P.B'||i||j);
 --
 Procedure Found_conflict(r number, c number) is begin
 Rtrn_TF := True;
 Set_item_property('P.B'||i||j,Visual_attribute,'IMPOSSIBLE');
 Set_item_property('P.B'||i||c,Visual_attribute,'IMPOSSIBLE');
 End Found_conflict;
 Begin
 If C1 is null
 or Length(C1) > 1 then
 Return(Rtrn_TF);
 End if;
 -- Check for dup in row --
 for c in 1..9 loop
 If c <> j
 And C1 = Name_in('P.B'||i||c) then
 Found_conflict(i,c);
 End if;
 End loop;
 -- check for dup in column --
 for r in 1..9 loop
 If r <> i
 And C1 = Name_in('P.B'||r||j) then
 Found_conflict(r,j);
 End if;
 End loop;
 -- check for dup in box --
 declare
 a pls_integer := trunc((i-1)/3)*3+1; --r,c of first item of a box
 b pls_integer := trunc((j-1)/3)*3+1;
 begin
 for r in a..a+2 loop
 for c in b..b+2 loop
 If (r <> i or c <> j)
 And C1 = Name_in('P.B'||r||c) then
 Found_conflict(r,c);
 End if;
 End loop;
 End loop;
 end;
 Return(Rtrn_TF);
 End Duplicate_Single;


 Procedure Remove_C1_from_other_fields
 -------------------------------------
 (row_i pls_integer,
 col_i pls_integer)
 is
 P2 varchar2(9);
 i pls_integer := trunc((row_i-1)/3)*3+1; --r,c of first item of box
 j pls_integer := trunc((col_i-1)/3)*3+1;
 Begin
 -- Remove from other hints in row
 For c in 1..9 loop
 If c <> col_i then
 P2 := Name_in('P.B'||row_i||c);
 If instr(P2,C1) > 0 then
 P2 := translate(P2,'*'||C1,'*');
 Copy(P2,'P.B'||row_i||c);
 If nvl(Length(C2),0) < 2 then
 cnt_single := cnt_single + 1;
 End if;
 End if;
 End if;
 End loop;
 -- Remove from other hints in column
 For r in 1..9 loop
 If r <> row_i then
 P2 := Name_in('P.B'||r||col_i);
 If instr(P2,C1) > 0 then
 P2 := translate(P2,'*'||C1,'*');
 Copy(P2,'P.B'||r||col_i);
 If nvl(Length(C2),0) < 2 then
 cnt_single := cnt_single + 1;
 End if;
 End if;
 End if;
 End loop;
 -- Remove from other hints in block
 i := trunc((row_i-1)/3)*3+1; --i,j are r,c of first item of a box
 j := trunc((col_i-1)/3)*3+1;
 for r in i..i+2 loop
 for c in j..j+2 loop
 If r <> row_i or c <> col_i then
 P2 := Name_in('P.B'||r||c);
 If instr(P2,C1) > 0 then
 P2 := translate(P2,'*'||C1,'*');
 Copy(P2,'P.B'||r||c);
 If nvl(Length(C2),0) < 2 then
 cnt_single := cnt_single + 1;
 End if;
 End if;
 End if;
 End loop;
 End loop;
 End Remove_C1_from_other_fields;


 Procedure Find_Uniques is begin
 -------------------------------
 Found_string := null;
 P0.cnt_done := 0;
 For r in 1..9 Loop
 For c in 1..9 Loop
 If Name_in('D.B'||r||c) is not null then
 P0.cnt_done := P0.cnt_done + 1;
 Else
 P := Name_in('P.B'||r||c);
 If Length(P)> 1 then
 For i in 1..Length(P) Loop
 C1 := substr(P,i,1); --C1 is single digit being processed
 C2 := '%'||C1||'%';
 check_row(r,c);
 If found1 then -- C is unique in its location
 check_column(r,c);
 If found1 then -- C is unique in its location
 check_box(r,c);
 End if;
 End if;
 If not nvl(found1,False) then--C1 is unique in its location
 --Copy(C1,'P.B'||r||c);
 -- concat 3 chars into found_string
 Found_string := Found_string || C1 || r || c;
 cnt_single := cnt_single + 1;
 --Remove_C1_from_other_fields(r,c);
 Exit;
 End if;
 End loop;
 End if;
 End if;
 End loop;
 End loop;
 -- Now display the unique values in their respective locations
 declare
 r pls_integer;
 c pls_integer;
 begin
 Loop
 exit when Found_string is null;
 C1 := substr(Found_string,-3,1);
 r := substr(Found_string,-2,1);
 c := substr(Found_string,-1,1);
 If length(Found_string) = 3 then --first unique found
 Go_item('D.B'||r||c);
 Found_string := null;
 Else
 Found_string := substr(Found_string,1,Length(Found_string)-3);
 End if;
 Copy(C1,'P.B'||r||c);
 If Duplicate_Single(r,c) then
 Go_item('D.B'||r||c);
 If Find_All = 'N' then
 Message(' Dup uniques: B'||r||c);
 End if;
 Raise Form_trigger_failure;
 End if;
 Set_item_property('P.B'||r||c,Visual_attribute,'SINGLE');
 If Find_All = 'Y' then
 Remove_C1_from_other_fields(r,c);
 End if;
 End loop;
 end;
 End Find_Uniques;

Begin ---- Main process
 Validate(form_scope);
 If not form_success then
 Raise form_trigger_failure;
 End if;
 --
 P0.cnt_single := 0;
 Loop -- Repeat until no more uniques can be found
 cnt_single := 0;
 Find_Uniques;
 P0.cnt_single := P0.cnt_single + cnt_single;
 exit when cnt_single = 0
 or Find_All = 'N'; -- only want to find first uniques
 End loop;
End P06_Find_Uniques;

Procedure P08_Try_to_solve( Do_guess varchar2 := 'Y' ) is
-- This process solves the puzzle as quickly as possible without
-- stopping.
-- Do_guess: Y = process will guess if necessary (when no other 
-- methods used find any unique values).
-- N = process stops when no possible or unique values
-- can be found, but solution is incomplete.
-- Ctrl- (or shift-) click on the Try to Solve button
-- sets Do_Guess to N.
--
 P_cnt pls_integer := 0;
 U_cnt pls_integer := 0;
 Guess_cnt pls_integer := 0;
 cnt_txt varchar2(50);
 Timr timer;

 Function counts return varchar2 is begin
 ----------------------
 If P_cnt > 1 then
 cnt_txt := ' P = ' || P_cnt
 || ', U = ' || U_cnt
 || ', G = ' || Guess_cnt;
 End if;
 Return cnt_txt;
 End counts;

 Procedure Try_other_methods is
 ------------------------------
 exit_loop boolean;
 procedure check_changes is begin
 if P0.cnt_changes > 0 then
 exit_loop := false;
 end if;
 End check_changes;
 begin
 Loop
 exit_loop := true;
 P13_Check_For_Pairs;
 check_changes;
 P11_Line_block_intersect;
 check_changes;
 P12_Lines_in_block;
 check_changes;
 exit when exit_loop;
 End loop;
 begin
 U_cnt := U_cnt + 1;
 P06_Find_Uniques(Find_All => 'Y');
 exception when others then
 P0.cnt_single := 0;
 end;
 End Try_other_methods;

 Procedure Check_Possibles is begin
 -------------------------
 If P0.cnt_done < 81 then
 P_cnt := P_cnt + 1;
 P05_Find_Possibles;
 End if;
 If P0.cnt_done = 81 then
 Message(' SOLUTION COMPLETED'||counts);
 Return;
 End if;
 If P0.cnt_none_possible > 0
 And Do_guess = 'N' then
 Message(' SOLUTION IS IMPOSSIBLE.');
 Return;
 End if;
 End Check_possibles;

 Procedure solve_main is begin
 -----------------------------
 Loop
 Check_Possibles;
 Exit when P0.cnt_done = 81 --completed
 or P0.cnt_none_possible > 0;
 If P0.cnt_single > 0 then
 begin
 P07_Post_numbers(one_step => 'N');
 exception when others then
 P0.cnt_single := 0; -- exit without stopping
 end;
 Else
 begin
 U_cnt := U_cnt + 1;
 P06_Find_Uniques(Find_All => 'Y');
 exception when others then
 P0.cnt_single := 0;
 end;
 If P0.cnt_single = 0 then
 Try_other_methods;
 End if;
 If P0.cnt_single > 0 then
 begin
 P07_Post_numbers(one_step => 'N');
 exception when others then
 P0.cnt_single := 0; -- exit without stopping
 end;
 Elsif Do_guess = 'N' then
 Message(' SOLUTION IS INCOMPLETE.');
 End if;
 End if;
 Exit when P0.cnt_single = 0;
 End loop;
 End solve_main;

 Procedure Guess_main is
 -----------------------
 num_vals varchar2(81);
 C1 varchar2(1);
 C9 varchar2(9);
 procedure restore_values is begin
 for r in 1..9 loop
 for c in 1..9 loop
 C1 := substr(num_vals,9*r-9+c,1);
 If C1 = ' ' then
 Copy(' ','D.B'||r||c);
 End if;
 end loop;
 end loop;
 end restore_values;
 Procedure Set_guess_value is
 -- Looks at each pair of possibles, and for each pair, chooses
 -- the first, then the second, and places it in the solution
 -- field.
 Pair_cnt pls_integer := 0;
 Begin
 P05_Find_Possibles;
 C1 := null;
 for r in 1..9 loop
 for c in 1..9 loop
 C9 := Name_in('P.B'||r||c);
 If length(C9) = 2 then
 Pair_cnt := Pair_cnt + 1;
 If round(Guess_cnt/2)=Pair_cnt then
 C1 := substr(C9,1+mod(Guess_cnt+1,2),1);
 Copy(C1,'D.B'||r||c);
 Exit;
 End if;
 End if;
 if r=9 and c=9 then
 Message(' GUESS PROCESS HAS FAILED.'
 ||' CANNOT FIND A SOLUTION.');
 Raise Form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end loop;
 Exit when C1 is not null;
 end loop;
 End Set_guess_value;
 Begin
 -- Store_values
 for r in 1..9 loop
 for c in 1..9 loop
 num_vals := num_vals ||nvl(Name_in('D.B'||r||c),' ');
 end loop;
 end loop;
 Loop
 Restore_values;
 Guess_cnt := Guess_cnt + 1;
 Set_guess_value;
 solve_main;
 exit when P0.cnt_done = 81;
 End Loop;
 End Guess_main;

Begin
 If Do_Guess = 'Y' then
 Timr := create_timer('TRY_TO_SOLVE',500,No_repeat);
 End if;
 P0.cnt_done := 0;
 Loop
 Solve_Main;
 Exit when P0.cnt_done = 81 --completed
 or Do_Guess = 'N'
 and ( P0.cnt_single = 0
 or P0.cnt_none_possible > 0 );
 -- Need to guess at this point --
 Guess_Main;
 Exit when P0.cnt_done = 81; --completed
 End loop;
End P08_Try_to_solve;

Procedure P13_Check_for_pairs is
-- Check possible values in each row, column and box set. When a 
-- pair is found, check all other fields for the same pair. If the
-- matching pair is found, those two fields can only contain one or
-- the other value of that pair.
-- Once this is established, then remove the two values from all other
-- possible values in the set.
-- This should be used after the Check_Possibles is run.
 P varchar2(9);
 P2 varchar2(9);
 P3 varchar2(9);
 Type Grp_rec_typ is record
 (P varchar2(9), -- Possible digits
 R number, -- row of this element
 C number ); -- column of this element
 Grp_rec Grp_rec_typ;
 Type Grp_tbl_typ is table of Grp_Rec_typ
 index by binary_integer;
 Grp Grp_tbl_typ;

 Procedure Store_new_hint(P varchar2,r pls_integer,c pls_integer) is
 Begin
 P0.cnt_changes := P0.cnt_changes + 1;
 Copy(p,'P.B'||r||c);
 If p is null then
 P0.cnt_none_possible := P0.cnt_none_possible + 1;
 If P0.cnt_none_possible = 1 then
 P0.Impossible_itm := 'D.B'||r||c;
 End if;
 Set_item_property('P.B'||r||c,Visual_attribute,'IMPOSSIBLE');
 Elsif Length(p) = 1 then
 P0.cnt_single := P0.cnt_single + 1;
 If P0.cnt_single = 1 then
 P0.First_single_itm := 'D.B'||r||c;
 End if;
 Set_item_property('P.B'||r||c,Visual_attribute,'SINGLE');
 End if;
 End Store_new_hint;

 Procedure check_the_group is begin
 -- Grp table is loaded with 9 elements from a row, column or box.
 -- This process checks for two equal pairs of "possible" digits.
 -- If the two pairs are found, remove those two digits from all
 -- other elements in the group, then call store_new_hint
 -- to change the hint (possible numbers) on the screen.
 for i in 1..9 loop
 P := Grp(i).P;
 If length(P) = 2 then --found a pair
 for j in i+1..9 loop
 If Grp(j).P = P then --found a matching pair
 for k in 1..9 loop
 If k not in(i,j) then
 P2 := Grp(k).P;
 If P2 <> '*' then
 P3 := translate(P2,'*'||P,'*'); --remove pair digits
 If nvl(P3,' ') <> P2 then
 store_new_hint(P3,Grp(k).R,Grp(k).C);
 End if;
 End if;
 End if;
 End loop;
 End if;
 End loop;
 End if;
 End loop;
 End check_the_group;

 Procedure set_group_element(i pls_integer,r number,c number) is begin
 -- sets each of the 9 elements in the grp array. After 9th is
 -- set, calls the group check, then reinitialize grp array.
 Grp(i).R := r;
 Grp(i).C := c;
 If Name_in('D.B'||r||c) is not null then
 Grp(i).P := '*';
 Else
 Grp(i).P := Name_in('P.B'||r||c);
 End if;
 If i=9 then
 Check_the_group;
 Grp.delete;
 End if;
 End set_group_element;

Begin

 If not form_success then
 Raise form_trigger_failure;
 End if;
 --
 P0.cnt_done := 0;
 P0.cnt_none_possible := 0;
 P0.cnt_single := 0;
 P0.cnt_changes := 0;

 -- Check each row --
 For r in 1..9 Loop
 For c in 1..9 Loop
 Set_group_element(c,r,c);
 End loop;
 End loop;

 -- Check each column --
 For c in 1..9 Loop
 For r in 1..9 Loop
 Set_group_element(r,r,c);
 End loop;
 End loop;

 -- Check each box --
 Declare
 i pls_integer;
 r2 pls_integer;
 c2 pls_integer;
 Begin
 for r1 in 1..3 loop
 r2 := 3*r1-2; -- = 1,4,7
 for c1 in 1..3 loop

 End loop;

 End loop;
 End;

End P13_Check_for_pairs;

PROCEDURE P11_Line_Block_intersect IS
-- Looking at a single line (row or column), if a possible number
-- candidate in the line lies only in the three
-- spots of ONE of the blocks it intersects and NOT in the other two
-- blocks, then that candidate MUST be in that line within the block.
-- Therefore, if the possible number candidate appears anywhere else
-- in the block, it can be removed.
 Used_numbers varchar2(9);
 Possibles varchar2(9);
 Char1 varchar2(1);
 Occurs varchar2(3);
 row_col_txt varchar2(20);
 --
 Function Check_3_parts_in_row(row1 pls_integer,char1 varchar2)
 -----------------------------
 return varchar2 is
 j pls_integer;
 Rtrn varchar2(3); -- = 1, 2, 3 or 12, 13, 23, or 123
 -- indicates which blocks have char1.
 Begin
 For i in 1..3 loop
 j := 3*i-2;
 for k in j..j+2 loop
 if Nvl(instr(Name_in('P.B'||row1||k),char1),0) > 0 then
 Rtrn := Rtrn || to_char(i);
 exit;
 end if;
 End loop;
 exit when length(Rtrn) > 1;
 End loop;
 Return Rtrn;
 End Check_3_parts_in_row;
 --
 Function Check_3_parts_in_col(col1 pls_integer,char1 varchar2)
 -----------------------------
 return varchar2 is
 j pls_integer;
 Rtrn varchar2(3); -- = 1, 2, 3 or 12, 13, 23, or 123
 -- indicates which blocks have char1.
 Begin
 For i in 1..3 loop
 j := 3*i-2;
 for k in j..j+2 loop
 if Nvl(instr(Name_in('P.B'||k||col1),char1),0) > 0 then
 Rtrn := Rtrn || to_char(i);
 exit;
 end if;
 End loop;
 exit when length(Rtrn) > 1;
 End loop;
 Return Rtrn;
 End Check_3_parts_in_col;
 --
 Procedure Check_remove(Char1 varchar2, r pls_integer, c pls_integer) is
 -----------------------
 Poss1 varchar2(9);
 Poss2 varchar2(9);
 Begin
 Poss1 := Name_in('P.B'||r||c);
 If instr(Poss1,Char1) > 0 then
 P0.cnt_changes := P0.cnt_changes + 1;
 Poss2 := translate(Poss1,'*'||Char1,'*');
zz('P11_LBI '||row_col_txt||'Remove '||char1||' from candidates at R'||r||'C'||c
||', <'||Poss1||'> --> <'||Poss2||'>');
 Copy(Poss2,'P.B'||r||c);
 If Length(Poss2) = 1 then
 P0.cnt_single := P0.cnt_single + 1;
 If P0.Cnt_single = 1 then
 P0.First_single_itm := 'D.B'||r||c;
 End if;
 Set_item_property('P.B'||r||c,Visual_attribute,'SINGLE');
 End if;
 End if;
 End Check_remove;

 (Char1 varchar2, Occurs varchar2, r pls_integer) is

 c1 pls_integer := 3*Occurs-2;
 Begin

 If r2 <> r then

 (Char1 varchar2, Occurs varchar2, c pls_integer) is

PROCEDURE P12_Lines_in_Block IS
-- Within each block, looking at each 3-number line, if a possible
-- number candidate only appears on one of the three lines, and NOT
-- in the other two lines, then that candidate MUST be in that line
-- within the block.
-- So, if the possible number candidate appears in the same line
-- but outside the block, it can be removed from those places.
-- This is Technique #3, "Candidate Lines" at www.sudokuoftheday.com
 c2 pls_integer;
 r2 pls_integer;
 Possibles varchar2(9);
 Char1 varchar2(1);
 Occurs varchar2(3);
 row_col_txt varchar2(20);
 --
 Procedure Check_remove(Char1 varchar2, r pls_integer, c pls_integer) is
 -----------------------
 Poss1 varchar2(9);
 Poss2 varchar2(9);
 Begin
 Poss1 := Name_in('P.B'||r||c);
 If instr(Poss1,Char1) > 0 then
 P0.cnt_changes := P0.cnt_changes + 1;
 Poss2 := translate(Poss1,'*'||Char1,'*');
zz('P12_LiB '||row_col_txt||'Remove '||char1||' from candidates at R'||r||'C'||c
||', <'||Poss1||'> --> <'||Poss2||'>');
 Copy(Poss2,'P.B'||r||c);
 If Length(Poss2) = 1 then
 P0.cnt_single := P0.cnt_single + 1;
 If P0.Cnt_single = 1 then
 P0.First_single_itm := 'D.B'||r||c;
 End if;
 Set_item_property('P.B'||r||c,Visual_attribute,'SINGLE');
 P0.cnt_single := P0.cnt_single + 1;
 End if;
 End if;
 End Check_remove;


 Procedure Check_lines_in_block(r1 in pls_integer, c1 pls_integer) is
 ------------------------------
 Line_cnt pls_integer := 0;
 rc pls_integer;
 Poss1 varchar2(9);
 Poss2 varchar2(9);
 Begin
 -- check 3 rows --
 for r in r1..r1+2 loop
 for c in c1..c1+2 loop
 If instr(Name_in('P.B'||r||c),Char1) > 0 then
 Line_cnt := Line_cnt + 1;
 rc := r;
 exit;
 End if;
 end loop;
 exit when Line_cnt > 1;
 end loop;
 --
 If Line_cnt = 1 then
 -- Char1 only exists in one row in block. Remove Char1 from
 -- any possibles in same line but outside the block.
 row_col_txt := 'row '||rc||': ';
 For c in 1..9 loop
 If c not between c1 and c1+2 then
 Check_remove(Char1,rc,c);
 End if;
 End loop;
 End if;

 -- check 3 columns --
 Line_cnt := 0;
 for c in c1..c1+2 loop
 for r in r1..r1+2 loop
 If instr(Name_in('P.B'||r||c),Char1) > 0 then
 Line_cnt := Line_cnt + 1;
 rc := c;
 exit;
 End if;
 end loop;
 exit when Line_cnt > 1;
 end loop;

 -- Char1 only exists in one column in block. Remove Char1 from
 -- any possibles in same column outside the block.
 row_col_txt := 'column '||rc||': ';
 For r in 1..9 loop
 If r not between r1 and r1+2 then
 Check_remove(Char1,r,rc);
 End if;
 End loop;
 End if;
 End Check_lines_in_block;
 --
 Procedure check_block(r1 pls_integer,c1 pls_integer,

 Begin

 For i in 1..nvl(Length(Possibles),0) loop

 End check_block;

In more complex puzzles, the above methods are not enough to find a solution. At that point, clicking The "Find Possibles" and "Find Uniques" buttons can find no other singles. You can then try any of the other technique buttons: "Check for Pairs", "Line Block Intersect" and "Check Lines in Block". These methods examine groups of possible candidates, and if possible, remove some of the candidates from some of the squares. The buttons can be clicked repeatedly until no more changes are made.

The above techniques will not solve the most difficult puzzles. There are more complex techniques, but they are not written in this program. Instead, this program will guess at solutions until the correct one is found. Clicking the "Quick Solve" button uses all the existing techniques, and then guesses at the remaining squares. When the process completes, it reports the number of guesses required: (P = number of times the "Find Possibles" process was repeated; U = the number of times the "Find Uniques" process was repeated, and G = the number of guesses attempted.)

Additional features: 

Shift-click the "Quick Solve" button to try to solve without guessing. If not possible, it stops and reports "Solution is incomplete."

"Solve Step-by-Step" posts the numbers slowly, so you can watch the game being solved.

Blank line at the bottom: Double-click at any time to copy the existing numbers of the game into an 81-character string. This can be used to send the game numbers to someone or someplace else. Shift-Double-click does the same thing, but includes separators, with dots instead of spaces. Ctrl-Alt-Shift-Double-click does the opposite, using the numbers on the line to populate the squares so you can start a game.

Double-click on a square''s list of possible candidates makes that particular field updateable, so you can enter your own list of possible candidates. You can use this when applying more complex techniques to solving a puzzle. Note that the "Find Possibles" button will repopulate these fields with the full set of possible candidates.

 function overlap(n1 number,n2 number,x number,y number)
 return boolean is
 begin
 -- This condition returns True if one pair overlaps the other,

 return ( least(x,y) <= greatest(n1,n2)
 AND greatest(x,y) >= least(n1,n2) ) ;
 end overlap;
